title: the meowers pak
description: pack for some friends, including trains, magic, and quality of life!
body:
Trains and engineering! Woohoo!
----------

If your looking to have a modpack experience with a focus on trains and engineering, with a side of magic and exploration, the meowers pack is for you! The modpack does not modify much of the central mechanics of minecraft, rather adding complex engineering equipment, artifacts, and magic to enrich the base experience.

As previously mentioned, the primary focus of the pack is its engineering elements. The mods Mekanism, Create, and Tinkers construct serve to achieve this goal. Create is the main focus of this trio, featuring many addon mods for it, such as "Steam and Rails" and lots of other create based train creation! 

The mod also features lots of quality of life/optimization mods! This is essential to creating a smooth experience with both a heavily modded experience, and one that supports multiplayer. 

Also included are some player visual mods and texture packs to add new flavor to the game! Mods such as CPM and Figura support custom character creation, enabling the player to truly express themselves in all levels of play.

Structure mods and artifacts enrich exploration via many of the "Yungs structures" mods, and artifacts! Mods such as Biomes o plenty and incindium add more variety to the terrain itself.

Iron spellbooks is a complex spell casting mod for those looking to unleash their inner mage! 

Honerable mentions include exposure for those who love photography, farmers delight who want more in depth cooking, and Alex mobs+Quark for greater mob variety.
